subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should OpenClaw fix this Telegram SOCKS/HTTP proxy stall by changing the shared Undici proxy scheme handling across explicit and env proxy routes, or keep this as operator proxy guidance until stronger live proof is supplied?
rationale: The source and Undici contract make the proxy failure plausible, but the remaining choice affects shared proxy semantics and needs maintainer intent plus live Telegram proof.

options.title: Repair the shared proxy path
options.body: Require #84582 or a replacement to cover explicit and env proxy scheme handling with tests and redacted live Telegram SOCKS5 proof before merge.

options.title: Keep guidance only for now
options.body: Leave the issue open as needs-live-repro and document the supported proxy/DNS workarounds until a maintainer or reporter supplies stronger proof.

options.title: Scope to explicit proxy only
options.body: Accept a narrower explicit-proxy fix if maintainers decide env proxy behavior is a separate compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Repair the shared proxy path
recommendation.body: Require #84582 or a replacement to cover explicit and env proxy scheme handling with tests and redacted live Telegram SOCKS5 proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the shared proxy helper and Telegram transport boundary, and steipete is the strongest current history signal on the shared helper and recent proxy hardening.
